summary: The median and source-replay repairs pass, but a new option-distance shortcut answers three of five delivered batch items. Every normal distractor is within 2 lb of the key, so a unique choice within 2 lb of all others identifies it without modeling. Package unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Construct and solve a well-mixed variable-volume first-order linear mixture model, determine the overflow time from capacity, and evaluate solute mass there.
reasoning_steps: Find net volume growth and overflow time.
Compute solute inflow and time-dependent outflow.
Use a variable-coefficient integrating factor and the initial condition.
Evaluate at overflow and round to one decimal place.
invariants: Well-mixed single tank, constant positive inflow/outflow and incoming concentration.
Capacity greater than initial volume and inflow greater than outflow so a finite positive overflow time exists.
Mass balance, initial condition, capacity-defined evaluation time and consistent units.
Five numerical radio choices with one correct rounded mass.
permitted_variations: Capacity, initial volume, initial mass, feed concentration, net flow, physical context, and nearby distractor offsets can vary jointly with consistent solutions.
Correct choice position and numerical rank are incidental and eligible to vary independently of context and parameter patterns.
Context names and common positive rescaling of both flows are irrelevant to final overflow mass, though overflow time changes.
Feed concentration, initial mass, capacity or volume changes must recompute the response; no source license fixes a correct label, rank or distractor configuration.
Source more-concentrated wording constrains initial/feed concentration ordering; opposing order would require changed wording and scope justification.

grading.details: Native grader accepts 26 independently computed correct choices and rejects all 104 distractors. It also accepts four shortcut-produced choices, confirming the pedagogical bypass. Radio response shape has no free-entry equivalence requirement.

decision_variation.details: Correct roles vary but option-radius geometry remains answer-bearing: select the unique choice no farther than 2 lb from every other choice. Proven by construction and reproduced before/after delivery and in real grading. Ten historical median-affected stored records are retained separately.

findings.description: method_bank restricts every distractor to at most 20 tenths from the key. Therefore the key always lies within 2 lb of all options. In the recognizable subgroup where just one option has that property, its identity determines the answer without reading the tank problem. This answers 5/44 independent samples and 3/5 exact delivered batch records; all cue-selected native grader responses are accepted.
